english.title: Knowingly concerned in the fraudulent evasion of a prohibition / restriction on the import / export of nuclear material
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were knowingly concerned in

(A)_[the fraudulent evasion of]_
(B)_[an attempt to fraudulently evade]_

(C)_[a prohibition]_
(D)_[a restriction, namely **(..SPECIFY RESTRICTION..),]_

on the

(E)_[importation]_
(F)_[exportation]_
(G)_[shipment as stores]_

of nuclear material
english.legislation: Contrary to section 170(2), (3) and (4C) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
knowingly concerned in
fraudulent evasion / attempt at evasion
of a prohibition / restriction relating to the
importation / exportation / shipment as stores
of nuclear material

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Any goods in respect of which an offence under this section is committed shall be liable to forfeiture.

(A)_[osgoi'n dwyllodrus]_
(B)_[ymgais i osgoi'n dwyllodrus]_

(C)_[waharddiad]_
(D)_[gyfyngiad, sef **(..SPECIFY THE RESTRICTION..),]_

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a penalty of £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater.
Indictment: Fourteen years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
